ev.q: A total of 75 persons had illness that met the case definition
A total of 70 (93%) patients reported drinking unpasteurized milk
Signs and symptoms of illness included diarrhea (93%), abdominal cramps (92%), fever (76%)
Four (5%) patients did not drink unpasteurized milk but were mothers of ill children
None of the patients was hospitalized, and none had Guillain-Barre syndrome
This report summarizes the investigation of these and other cases

methods_quotes.q: Pulsed-field gel electrophoresis (PFGE) was performed on 21 isolates; the patterns were indistinguishable when restricted separately by two enzymes.
